    Simple dimensions for a complete primitive-projective presentation #

    A complete orthogonal family decomposes every right module into its idempotent coordinates. When the family contains exactly one primitive projective from each selected isomorphism class, algebraic closedness makes every simple right module one-dimensional. Consequently a semisimple module of composition length at most two has ground-field dimension at most two.
